history.summary: A 4BR at Piermont Grand, a large 820-unit Punggol EC (TOP 2023, CDL/TID) just 300m from Sumang LRT, asking $1.8M ($1,724 psf). The project has already re-rated from a ~$1,100-1,200 psf launch to a $1,724-1,786 psf resale range, and this listing sits at the bottom of that band with Punggol Digital District and CRL as forward catalysts.
history.rating_rationale: Strongest fundamentals in the batch: large 820-unit EC (deep, liquid), 300m to Sumang LRT, TOP 2023 so MOP completes ~2028 opening it to the open resale market and eventual privatization. $1,724 psf is the floor of the current $1,724-1,786 resale band, and the project already proved ~50% appreciation off launch. $1.8M sits in a workable family band, with PDD jobs and CRL connectivity as durable demand drivers.
red_flags: Still within EC MOP window — open-market resale fully unlocks ~2028
99-yr leasehold; Punggol has competing EC/new-launch supply
ABSD/EC eligibility rules narrow the near-term resale pool until MOP
catalysts: Punggol Digital District jobs + SIT campus driving tenant/buyer demand
Post-MOP open-market access + long-run privatization premium
